name: Pipescript — Named-Thread Estate Traversal
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-15 (2 direct messages, overriding the DEBTSCAN homing): a STANDALONE capability whose deliverable is a named-thread traversal over the whole estate. `pipescript <name>` (pipescript news / insurance / mdpf / advi / model-portfolios / trade-submission / <portal-page>) returns EVERY resource in that thread + its dependencies + data-flow + frontend consumers. Single human-friendly entry point: 'what am I looking for? the news scanner? -> pipescript news -> see every resource in that pipeline'. The estate-coverage-manifest (6bea1582a) is the name->threads->owning_tool RESOLVER behind it; comp-pipescript (medallion) is demoted to ONE sub-resolver of several (globgrph AWS-resource / stitch cross-layer / portal-consumer-tools frontend / none ops-local). NOT folded under NFRA_DEBTSCAN — DEBTSCAN's orphan/dormant/stranded/freshness flags still flow to the debtscan ledger and are SURFACED in the traversal, but the thread-enumeration + named-traversal is its own project. Seed: CVO's NAMED_THREAD_CATALOG (d33fe4aab) pivoted the 2026-06-15 134-thread estate census (2d9a0a2a1) into 15 named threads at product/surface granularity.
phase: Phase 0: PRD v0.1 authored (CTO, Andrew-direct). Seed = the 15-named-thread catalog over the 134-thread census; resolver = estate-coverage-manifest; comp-pipescript = one sub-resolver. COO decomposition pending.
blocking: COO decomposition. Refinement of the 15 named threads (collapse advi firm-scoped bd/inf/cot; split per-portal-page per Andrew's 'each of the portal pages') is a P2 step in the PRD.
